scenarios.iid: independent events with the stationary category probabilities
scenarios.heterogeneous_iid: learner probabilities drawn from Dirichlet(20 * stationary probabilities); events independent within each learner
scenarios.markov: the specified homogeneous first-order Markov alternative

intervals: pointwise 95% Clopper-Pearson intervals across independent simulations
scope: global exchangeability test only; no cell-specific FDR or bootstrap-coverage claim
interpretation: Rates have Monte Carlo uncertainty; compatibility with alpha is not proof of exact calibration.
